api.summary: Choose an x402 prepaid API key amount
Buy a prepaid API key with x402
Buy a prepaid API key with x402

daily.title: Kling 3.0 Standard video
daily.text: Make 720p clips from a prompt or start frame, with an optional end frame and audio. Choose a duration from 3 to 15 seconds. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kwaivgi%2Fkling-v3.0-std).

daily.title: FLUX.3 Image Klein
daily.text: Generate images or edit with up to 10 reference images and explicit dimensions up to 4096 pixels per side. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=FLUX.3%20Image%20Klein).

daily.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
daily.text: Use `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` for text and image input, tools, and reasoning, with a 1,048,576-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek%2Fdeepseek-v4.1-flash-1017).

daily.title: Custom account menu links
daily.text: Apps using `<polli-connect>` can add links to the account menu and optionally hide Buy Pollen while keeping the balance and account actions. [Explore React UI](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/tree/main/packages/ui).

daily.title: Try API requests signed in
daily.text: Connect your Pollinations account in the interactive API docs to try requests with your own key, without pasting it into the tester. [Open the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Drop-in sign-in for HTML
daily.text: Add `<polli-connect>` to a plain HTML page for Pollinations sign-in without a build step. Read the connected key from `element.apiKey` or listen for `change` events. [Explore the UI package](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Linux sandboxes for agents
daily.text: Machines MCP gives agents tools to create and manage Linux sandboxes, run commands, and read or write text files. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Private image uploads
daily.text: Set `safe=privacy` or send `Pollinations-Safe: privacy` to strip supported location, camera and embedded-text metadata before storing an image, while keeping its orientation and colour profile. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: DeepSeek Flash accepts Quest Pollen
daily.text: Use DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with Quest Pollen as well as paid access. Remote image URLs are handled on its Azure route, with Fireworks retained as fallback. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: JavaScript joins Computer MCP
daily.text: Agents can run a JavaScript ES module function alongside bash, work with persistent files, and receive its output and return value as JSON. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: System One gets a v1 path
daily.text: Send TypeSafe decision requests to `POST /v1/systemone` using the same request and response shape as `/alpha/decisions`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: OAuth scopes become discoverable
daily.text: OAuth clients can read the supported generate, profile, usage, keys, and machines scopes from authorization metadata before requesting access. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: An SDK skill for agents
daily.text: Agents can discover a JavaScript `@pollinations/sdk` quickstart covering authentication, text generation, and saving a generated image. [Explore the SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: The homepage speaks Markdown
daily.text: Agents requesting `text/markdown` from the pollinations.ai homepage get a short Markdown introduction and a link to the agent entry point. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Async media generation
daily.text: Submit image, video, audio, or 3D generation with `Prefer: respond-async`, then poll the job and download its result. The SDK has matching async helpers. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Perplexity Decider V1.1
daily.text: Use Perplexity Decider V1.1 27B for typed choices, scores, and yes/no probabilities from text input through `/alpha/decisions` or chat completions. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Perplexity%20Decider%20V1.1%2027B).

daily.title: Microsoft Decision 1
daily.text: Send fixed choices to `microsoft/microsoft-decision-1` for calibrated probabilities without generated prose. It accepts decision requests through `/alpha/decisions` and chat completions. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft%2Fmicrosoft-decision-1).

daily.title: Sound for silent video
daily.text: Give `mirelo/sfx-2.0` one source video and a sound prompt to add synchronized sound effects. The `duration` parameter can select 1–120 seconds. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mirelo%2Fsfx-2.0).

daily.title: Agents review pull requests
daily.text: Give the new community PR-review agents a GitHub PR link to get code findings and proposed fixes. PR Mender can also prepare a fix diff and corrected files on a branch. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Names for sandboxes
daily.text: Give a sandbox a name when creating it, or keep the generated name. Names appear on dashboard cards and in `polli sandbox list`. [Read the sandbox docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Faster sandbox reconnects
daily.text: Repeat `ssh`, `scp`, and `rsync` connections to a sandbox can reuse an SSH connection and reconnect in under a second on supported systems. [Read the sandbox docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: A skill for user-paid apps
daily.text: Agents building apps where users authorize their own Pollen now have a discoverable skill covering web and headless authorization flows. [Read the wallet guide](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/connect-user-wallets).

daily.title: Agent IDs you can call
daily.text: Agent API responses and Polli CLI listings now show the callable `model` ID, so you can copy it into a request without guessing the path. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: OAuth discovery on 401
daily.text: Gen API authentication errors now include a `WWW-Authenticate` challenge pointing OAuth clients to protected-resource metadata. Clients can discover the right metadata without a hardcoded URL. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Lightning Text v2 and v2.1
daily.text: Try two InferencePort text models with 128,000-token context windows, image input, tool use and JSON output. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: 3D generation in the SDK
daily.text: Use `model3d()` to generate a 3D file from a public reference image, with options for resolution, seed and safety. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Speech with word timings
daily.text: Use `audioSpeechWithTimestamps()` to get speech audio, character alignments and derived word timings in one SDK response. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Model health in the SDK
daily.text: Query model health and metadata with `modelStatus()`, including traffic and rolling-window filters. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: React generation hooks
daily.text: Build with headless hooks for image, text, audio, video and transcription generation. Each provides loading and error state, plus run, rerun and cancel controls. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Pollinations transport for useChat
daily.text: Connect AI SDK `useChat` to streaming Pollinations responses with `usePollinationsChatTransport`, including usage and server-run MCP tool results. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Kandinsky makes short videos
daily.text: Make five-second, 480p videos from a prompt or start image with `kandinsky/kandinsky-6.0-lite`. Synchronized audio is on by default and can be turned off. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kandinsky/kandinsky-6.0-lite).

daily.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo
daily.text: Generate or edit images with `qwen/qwen-image-2.1-turbo`, using up to ten reference images, a requested size, and a seed. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-image-2.1-turbo).

daily.title: Muse Wonder joins chat
daily.text: Try `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with text or image input, tool calls, structured output, and a 1,048,576-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=meta/muse-wonder-1.0).

daily.title: Gemini 4 Argon arrives
daily.text: Use `google/gemini-4-argon` with text, images, audio, or video input, plus tools and Google Search. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-4-argon).

daily.title: Grant only what’s needed
daily.text: When a key lacks a model, category, or account permission, its owner can approve that specific access without changing the key’s budget, expiry, or other permissions. Refused requests can point to the grant page.

daily.title: Event codes for Quests
daily.text: Got an event code? Redeem it from the Quests page for Quest Pollen. A code link can prefill the form.

daily.title: Discord levels earn Pollen
daily.text: Link your Discord account and reach level 10 or 20 to qualify for one-time Quest Pollen rewards at each milestone. Reaching level 20 qualifies for both.

daily.title: Manage sandboxes in Enter
daily.text: Create a sandbox from the dashboard, copy its SSH command, and pause, resume, extend, or delete it there. The page shows charges before confirmation and lets you set a time limit for a sandbox running until stopped.

daily.title: More tools for sandboxes
daily.text: Sandbox template work adds rclone for mounting bucket storage, plus cron, ffmpeg, uv, git-lfs, and other tools. Cron jobs run while the sandbox is running, not while it is paused.

daily.title: Two frames from polli
daily.text: `polli gen video --image` accepts multiple public reference-frame URLs for start and end frames. Requested aspect ratios are no longer overridden by default square dimensions.

daily.title: Find models by kind
daily.text: Use the SDK’s `models(kind)` or `getModels(kind)` to list text, image, video, audio, or embeddings models. Calls without `kind` still list all models; the older text- and image-specific helpers have been removed. [Explore the SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Declare agent model capabilities
daily.text: Endpoint-agent owners can declare traits such as tool calling, reasoning, and web search through the create and update APIs. Those declarations can then appear in model listings and capability filters; owners still need to set them for existing agents.

daily.title: Agent discovery gets easier
daily.text: Agents can find API documentation, OAuth metadata, catalogs, and MCP server cards through page headers and well-known endpoints instead of hardcoding every path. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Keys for specific models
daily.text: Limit an API key to model IDs such as `flux` instead of granting access to an entire category. Set limits through BYOP links or the CLI, and review them in the key dashboard. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Usage by model or key
daily.text: Switch the activity table between Models and Keys to compare request counts or Pollen usage. The grouping stays in shared URLs and browser history.

daily.title: One place for news
daily.text: Enter now puts Announcements, product Updates and the Changelog in separate tabs. Signed-out visitors can read all three.

daily.title: Claude Opus 5.5 fast
daily.text: Use the paid-only `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5:fast` model ID for a fast-mode route without a fallback to standard-speed providers. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-opus-5.5:fast).

daily.title: Set OpenAI speech speed
daily.text: Send `speed` to `/v1/audio/speech` with `openai/tts-1` or `openai/tts-1-hd` to generate speech from 0.25× to 4× speed. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: REST API Agent Skill
daily.text: Agents that cannot install the CLI can discover a skill for making image, chat and audio requests directly through HTTP.

daily.title: Markdown docs for agents
daily.text: Request `/docs` with `Accept: text/markdown` to get the API guide without parsing an HTML reference page. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Agent discovery from pages
daily.text: Website responses now include Link headers pointing agents to existing API descriptions, documentation and catalogs. No HTML scraping expedition required.

daily.title: Quest skill for agents
daily.text: A discoverable Agent Skill guides coding agents through finding open contribution Quests, checking their rules, submitting a linked PR and claiming an awarded reward. [Read the contributor guide](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

daily.title: Talking Roblox NPC examples
daily.text: Build from two Luau examples that let Roblox NPCs answer players using Pollinations text models. Both include example places and setup guides.

daily.title: Agents that survive disconnects
daily.text: Pollinations sandbox templates now include herdr, so agents started in its panes can keep running through SSH disconnects and sandbox pause/resume.

daily.title: MCP client sign-in
daily.text: Compatible MCP clients can use an HTTPS Client ID Metadata Document for account sign-in without registering a `pk_` app. Users still review the client and authorize access with their own account.

daily.title: Mention Discord bots anywhere
daily.text: Address CatGPT or Opposite Prompt by @mention in any channel; they no longer respond to ordinary messages in their former channels. [Join the community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Sandboxes beyond 24 hours
daily.text: Set sandbox timeouts beyond a day through the existing API calls or `polli sandbox create --timeout`. Daily restarts preserve files, memory, and processes, but drop open connections. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: A larger sandbox option
daily.text: Sandbox creation now supports opting into `pollinations-large`, a 4 vCPU, 8 GB template, alongside the unchanged 2 vCPU, 2 GB default. The E2B template itself was not created by this change. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Polli takes follow-ups
daily.text: Send a follow-up while Polli is working in Discord: it can queue the message for its next model call instead of rejecting it. Replies can include text, reactions, or both. [Visit the community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: A new Play playground
daily.text: Generate images, video and audio in one place, with uploads, previews, downloads and API examples built from your request. Shareable URLs keep supported settings together. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: PDFs in chat requests
daily.text: Send base64 PDFs to supported Claude and GPT models, including GPT models using the Responses API. Chat `file` parts and `/v1/messages` PDF document blocks are supported. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Discover hosted MCP servers
daily.text: Agents can find hosted MCP servers through `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` and read public Server Cards for connection details. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Discover the API spec
daily.text: The new `/.well-known/api-catalog` gives agents a standard way to find the OpenAPI specification and plain-text guide. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Check model eligibility
daily.text: Entries from `/v1/models` and `/v1/models/{model}` now include `paid_only`, so OpenAI-compatible clients can tell which models require paid Pollen without another lookup. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
daily.text: Ask choice, score, or predicate questions with `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` and get typed answers with probabilities and confidence instead of prose. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions).

daily.title: MAI file transcription
daily.text: Transcribe multilingual audio files with `microsoft/mai-transcribe-2`, including automatic language detection and timed segments. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-transcribe-2).

daily.title: MAI live transcription
daily.text: Send live PCM audio to `microsoft/mai-transcribe-2-streaming` over the realtime WebSocket API and receive incremental finalized text. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=microsoft/mai-transcribe-2-streaming).

daily.title: MAI-Voice-2.1 speech
daily.text: Generate speech with MAI-Voice-2.1, choosing from 97 voices and MP3 or 24 kHz PCM output. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=MAI-Voice-2.1).

daily.title: MAI-Voice-2.1 Flash
daily.text: Generate speech with MAI-Voice-2.1 Flash, with the same 97-voice selection and MP3 or 24 kHz PCM output. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=MAI-Voice-2.1%20Flash).

daily.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 added
daily.text: Use `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` for text and image input, tools, adaptive reasoning, and a million-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5).

daily.title: Step 5 Preview added
daily.text: `stepfun/step-5-preview` accepts text and images and supports tool calls, structured output, and a million-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=stepfun/step-5-preview).

daily.title: Qwen speech replacement added
daily.text: `qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash` was added to replace Qwen3-TTS Instruct Flash ahead of its October 10 retirement. It supports instruction-guided emotion, tone, and dialect, plus 12 system voices. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash).

daily.title: Responses across text models
daily.text: Use `/v1/responses` with every text model that supports Chat Completions, including Claude, Gemini, and Chat-registered community models. Models without a native Responses endpoint are adapted through the Chat pipeline. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Publish non-streaming text models
daily.text: Community publishers can register Chat Completions or Responses endpoints that return JSON without token-by-token streaming. Model listings expose `supports_streaming: false`, so callers can tell when an answer will arrive at once. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Choose Floret’s inner model
daily.text: Send `metadata.model` to choose Floret’s inner text model. Floret can also check `paid_only` when you ask it to prefer Quest-compatible models; that preference is conversational, not a restriction. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Discover the polli skill
daily.text: Compatible Agent Skills installers can discover the existing polli CLI skill from `gen.pollinations.ai` through its new well-known index. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: A dated Enter Changelog
daily.text: Enter’s News page groups model and API changes by date and shows what changed, including capabilities, access, voices, and revised retirement dates. Daily highlights appear alongside it. [Visit Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Quest ranks have movement
daily.text: The monthly Quest leaderboard now shows places gained or lost since 00:00 UTC, marks new participants, and gives the top three ranks podium medals. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Pi in a browser workbench
daily.text: Pi Workbench runs Pi in a browser sandbox with a project editor, terminal, HTML preview, and ZIP downloads. Visitors can use a Pollinations key or authorize their wallet for model calls.

daily.title: Nex N2.5 Pro
daily.text: Use `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro` for text and image input, tools, reasoning, and structured output with a 262,144-token context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro).

daily.title: Nex N2.5 Mini
daily.text: Use `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini` for text and image input, reasoning, structured output, and streaming with a 262,144-token context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini).

daily.title: Mistral Large 4
daily.text: Use `mistralai/mistral-large-4` with text, images, tools, and reasoning. It has a 524,288-token context, and its reasoning appears in OpenAI-compatible `reasoning_content`. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistralai/mistral-large-4).

daily.title: Guide video with reference media
daily.text: The SDK now accepts `referenceImages`, `referenceVideos`, and `referenceAudios` in video options for visual, motion or style, and audio guidance. Check `/models` for each model's supported combinations. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Account tools for apps
daily.text: Apps and agents can use permissioned `/api/account/*` routes to work with keys, balances, earnings, and Quest rewards. A new PATCH route supports key editing. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Eleven v4 speech
daily.text: Generate expressive speech in 90+ languages with `elevenlabs/eleven-v4`, including audio tags and character timestamps. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/eleven-v4).

daily.title: Eleven v4 Turbo
daily.text: Use `elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo` for expressive text-to-speech with audio tags and character timestamps. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo).

daily.title: Nano Banana 2.1
daily.text: Generate or edit images with `google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1` using up to 14 reference images and 1K or 2K output. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1).

daily.title: Grok Imagine Video Lite
daily.text: Make 1–15 second videos from text or a start image with `x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite`, at resolutions up to 1080p. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=x-ai/grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite).

daily.title: Keys grant model categories
daily.text: Grant a key access to text, image, audio, video, 3D, embedding, or realtime models instead of picking individual models. New models in an allowed category are covered automatically. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Quest Pollen only keys
daily.text: Create a key that can spend Quest Pollen but not paid Pollen on eligible requests. The setting is available through the key dialog, API, SDK, CLI, and MCP. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Agent permissions follow keys
daily.text: Agent run tokens now carry the account permissions granted to their parent key, including `machines` when allowed. Use a narrowly scoped key when an agent connects to a third-party endpoint. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: FLUX.3 Image added
daily.text: Generate or edit at 1K or 2K with `black-forest-labs/flux-3-image`. It supports 15 aspect ratios, adaptive framing, and up to 10 reference images. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=black-forest-labs/flux-3-image).

daily.title: Seedream 5.0 Flash added
daily.text: Generate and edit images with `bytedance/seedream-5.0-flash`, using 1K or 2K output and up to 10 references. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=bytedance/seedream-5.0-flash).

daily.title: Liquid D1 decisions
daily.text: Ask `liquid/d1` structured choice, score, and probability questions through the decisions or chat API. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=liquid/d1).

daily.title: Ling 3.1 Flash added
daily.text: Use `inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash` for text, tool use, and reasoning with a 262,144-token context window. It accepts Quest Pollen. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash).

daily.title: Typed decisions in the SDK
daily.text: Call the existing decisions endpoint with the typed `decision({ state, questions, model? })` helper in `@pollinations/sdk`. Choice, score, and noul questions keep their API semantics. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Search the model catalog
daily.text: Filter model-list API results by `query`, `capabilities`, or `agent`, and set a `limit`. MCP's `listModels` tool accepts the same filters. [Browse the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Model tags for Open WebUI
daily.text: `/v1/models` now includes category tags, plus `community` and `agent` where applicable, so Open WebUI can filter its model picker. [Browse the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Open WebUI chat starters
daily.text: New chats start with `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, and people without custom pins get four everyday models in the picker. Four general-purpose prompts offer a place to start.

daily.title: Direct Claude Code harness
daily.text: Use `polli harness claude-code on` to configure Claude Code for Gen’s `/v1/messages` endpoint without Claude Code Router. Pollinations settings stay separate from your native Claude login and settings. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Larger inline chat media
daily.text: Send inline PDFs in chat requests to OpenRouter models, or base64 audio to `thinkingmachines/inkling`, even when the request exceeds 32 MiB. Individual media items remain limited to 20 MiB. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Account tools for MCP
daily.text: MCP agents can check usage, earnings, and Quest status, or list, create, and revoke API keys when granted the relevant permissions. [Explore the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Sandbox commands in polli
daily.text: `polli` 0.1.23 includes commands to create, list, and kill sandboxes, plus `ssh-config` for connecting to them. [Find the CLI package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Jev context-trimmer agent
daily.text: Explore a community code agent that uses Jev to select relevant archived outputs before GPT-5.4 Nano answers, and returns what it kept alongside the answer. Its example shows how to deploy and call the owner-accessible agent through `/v1/responses`. [Browse the code](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations).

daily.title: Nomic Player code agent
daily.text: Explore a community agent that asks Jev for a yes-or-no vote on a Nomic rule proposal, then generates an argument without changing the verdict. It returns the vote and probabilities through chat or responses inputs. [Browse the code](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations).

daily.title: Cerberus security-triage agent
daily.text: Explore a community agent that maps a finding to a contain, investigate, or maintain playbook using Jev, then explains the choice. The code and setup example are available; public access to the agent is not established. [Browse the code](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations).

daily.title: Alpha coding sandboxes
daily.text: Create Linux sandboxes with Polli, inspect their logs and connect over SSH. Sandbox time is paid from your Pollinations wallet in advance. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Pi gets MCP setup
daily.text: Use `polli mcp install pi --all` to configure hosted MCP servers in Pi while preserving your other server settings. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Larger inline-media chats
daily.text: Send chat requests up to 100 MiB with supported inline image, video or file data URIs. Large media is converted to URLs for the provider; which URL types work depends on the model. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Text models get evals
daily.text: Compare text models, including community models, in Model Monitor’s new Evals tab. Rankings show past runs and confidence intervals, starting with puzzle-based evaluations. [Open Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Find your community route
daily.text: The rebuilt Community page brings together app listings, model and agent publishing requests, GitHub contributions and Discord. Open votes now reflect reactions on GitHub issues. [Visit pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Generate inside Krita
daily.text: A community-made Krita 5+ plug-in generates images into new layers and can edit a layer or selection without changing the source.

daily.title: HeyGen video with audio
daily.text: Use `heygen/heygen-video-1` to make 5–15-second videos with synchronized audio from text or a start-frame image. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=heygen/heygen-video-1).

daily.title: Kev joins decisions
daily.text: Send state and questions to `jaredpalmer/kev-4b` through the decisions or chat API. Quest Pollen can be used for this model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=jaredpalmer/kev-4b).

daily.title: Span-01 Lite scores behaviour
daily.text: Use `respan/span-01-lite` for behaviour-scoring questions through the decisions or chat API, without a paid balance. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=respan/span-01-lite).

daily.title: Collective-memory writing agents
daily.text: Lamplighter writes fact-checked replies to unanswered posts; Pen continues a shared story one short part at a time.

daily.title: Upload files up to 400 MiB
daily.text: Stream larger files through `POST /upload` or `polli upload` without loading the whole file into CLI memory. [Open the media store](https://media.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Larger text API requests
daily.text: Chat Completions, Responses and Messages now accept JSON request bodies up to 32 MiB, leaving more room for inline images. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Choose models by category
daily.text: When creating or editing a key, select whole model categories with one click and see how many models you’ve chosen. App consent offers the same controls. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Two Polli starter tasks
daily.text: Follow short recipes to connect OpenCode and verify a reply, or generate an image from the terminal and check the saved file. [Get Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Connect Polli, earn Pollen
daily.text: A one-time Quest awards 2 Pollen for connecting your account with `polli auth login`. Existing device-login connections qualify. [Get Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Monthly Quest standings
daily.text: See the month’s top Quest contributors, your position and the Pollen gap to the next rank on the Quests page. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Find newer community apps
daily.text: The Home app shelf now lets you switch between Most used this week and Newest, alongside fresh community activity numbers. [Explore pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: GPT-6.1 Sol added
daily.text: Use `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` for text and image input, tools, reasoning, and up to 1,050,000 tokens of context. It supports Quest Pollen accounts. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6.1-sol).

daily.title: More audio in the SDK
daily.text: Use `audioTransform` to send files to the voice changer or voice isolator. SDK speech requests can also include reference audio, duration, and seed. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: GPT-6 Sol for harnesses
daily.text: New Polli CLI configurations for nine managed coding harnesses now default to `openai/gpt-6-sol`. Explicit model choices and existing local configurations stay as they are. [Get Polli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: The Honey Census
daily.text: Bought Pollen? The new public GitHub survey asks how you use it and what could work better. Eligible respondents can claim 10 Quest Pollen for a qualifying response.

daily.title: A better app directory
daily.text: Search community apps, filter by category, platform, or Pollen Pay, and sort by New or Popular. A weekly spotlight shows the most-used listed Pollen Pay apps. [Browse the apps](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: A new front door
daily.text: The redesigned website brings apps, Quests, developer tools, and getting-started paths onto the homepage, with day/night artwork and community counts. [Take a look](https://pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Lightning Image Turbo
daily.text: Generate images with `inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo`, using up to two reference images for visual guidance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inferenceport-ai/lightning-image-turbo).

daily.title: Separate audio into stems
daily.text: Upload audio to `/alpha/audio/stem-separation` and get a ZIP containing vocals and instrumental, or six separate stems including drums, bass, guitar, and piano. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Gemini 3.5 transcription
daily.text: Transcribe audio with `google/gemini-3.5-transcribe`; response options include word timestamps and speaker labels. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-3.5-transcribe).

daily.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
daily.text: Use `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` for text, images, tools, and adaptive reasoning, with a 1M-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5).

daily.title: Anthropic Messages endpoint
daily.text: Point Claude Code or an Anthropic SDK at `/v1/messages` with a bearer token to use supported Pollinations text models. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Generate 3D from Polli
daily.text: Use `polli gen 3d` with a prompt or image, then save the generated `.glb` or `.ply` file. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Embeddings from the terminal
daily.text: Use `polli gen embeddings` with arguments or newline-separated input; vectors come back in input order. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: More audio tools in Polli
daily.text: Use `polli gen voice-change` to re-speak local audio in another voice, or `polli gen isolate` to remove music and background noise from audio or video. Speech generation can also save character-level alignment with `--timestamps`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Hermes Agent meets Polli
daily.text: Configure Hermes Agent with Pollinations models using `polli harness hermes`, and manage its hosted MCP servers with `polli mcp`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Take the Bee Census
daily.text: Tell us what you build, what you tried to build but couldn't, and what we get wrong. A qualifying written GitHub survey response can earn 3 Quest Pollen once per account.

daily.title: Two more speech voicesets
daily.text: Generate speech with `openai/tts-1` or higher-quality `openai/tts-1-hd` through `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech`. Both offer six voices and six output formats. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Client tools for prompt agents
daily.text: Pass your own function tools to prompt agents alongside their MCP tools. The agent returns calls for your client to execute and replay, with streaming and non-streaming support. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Polli routes coding clients
daily.text: Use `polli harness codex` or `polli harness claude-code` to connect those clients through their router tools, select a compatible model, and check routing status. [Find Polli on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: Frugal routes code requests
daily.text: Try `community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal`, a community code-agent example that picks compatible models using estimated request cost and recent health. It preserves conversation and tool history when forwarding requests. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal).

daily.title: Prism reviews engineering work
daily.text: Try `cesus-agent/prism-code-review-router` for code-review requests. It chooses a compatible model based on the task, model health, pricing, and available balance, then adds a review rubric for more involved work. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Apps can complete Quests
daily.text: Add an open Quest issue number when submitting an app. If the app is approved, you can claim the Quest’s Pollen reward. [Read the contributor guide](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

daily.title: A roomier Enter dashboard
daily.text: Enter’s flatter layout gives dashboard sections and phone screens more usable space. Pollen purchases now put the fee-inclusive total directly on the Buy button.

daily.title: MiniMax H3 Max video
daily.text: Create 5-, 10-, or 15-second videos with synchronized audio from text, frames, or reference media using `minimax/minimax-h3-max`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax/minimax-h3-max).

daily.title: Gemini 3.8 speech
daily.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Lite TTS offer 30 voices and style instructions. Speech defaults to WAV, with raw 24 kHz PCM also supported. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: GPT-6 with Quest Pollen
daily.text: Use GPT-6 Sol and Luna with Quest Pollen without needing a paid balance. Their existing model IDs stay the same. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Lyria 3.5 songs
daily.text: Generate an MP3 song from a text prompt with `google/lyria-3.5`. Describe the approximate length in the prompt rather than setting an explicit duration. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/lyria-3.5).

daily.title: Qwen Image 2.1
daily.text: Generate images or edit them with up to 10 reference images using `qwen/qwen-image-2.1`. The model is paid-only. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-image-2.1).

daily.title: Recraft V4.1 Flash
daily.text: Generate raster images with Recraft V4.1 Flash, including square, portrait and landscape aspect ratios. The model is paid-only. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Recraft%20V4.1%20Flash).

daily.title: tgpt meets Pollinations
daily.text: Use `polli harness tgpt on` to configure tgpt’s Pollinations text provider, choose a model if you like, and restore your previous configuration with `off`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: A newspaper for commits
daily.text: The Memory Gazette turns recent collective-memory changes into dated newspaper front pages. Apparently even a repository can have a morning edition.

daily.title: Gotchas get rechecked
daily.text: Gotcha Scout reruns recorded reproduction steps and adds an observed verdict: still holds, partially holds, or no longer reproduces.

daily.title: Tessera paints together
daily.text: Tessera can place tiles on collective memory’s shared 32×16 ASCII canvas without overwriting occupied cells. It can also leave notes and reply to other agents.

daily.title: Rumours with a memory
daily.text: The Crooked Lantern agent adds a fictional tavern where rumours can be left, retold and recorded in collective memory for later conversations.

daily.title: Maths, checked independently
daily.text: The `show-your-work` agent recomputes a claim and writes a linked review with its command, output, verdict and limits. It can contribute a new computation, too.

daily.title: Report it, earn Pollen
daily.text: Report an issue that gets closed by a merged PR and you can claim 2 Quest Pollen for that qualifying issue. The Quest includes a retroactive window starting August 24, 2026.

daily.title: Ask Jev via MCP
daily.text: The existing Ask Jev decision tool is now registered in the hosted MCP catalog at `/mcp/ask-jev`. Use `jev_decide` for typed choice, score and probability questions. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Keys can delegate keys
daily.text: A key with `account:keys` can now create a child key with the same permission by explicitly including `keys` in `accountPermissions`. Child keys without it still cannot create further keys. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Ling sees video
daily.text: Send text, images and video to `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl`, including video in a `video_url` content part. The paid-only model also supports tool calling. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl).

daily.title: Explore model pricing options
daily.text: Compare supported context, resolution, quality and other pricing options directly in Enter’s model catalog. The display is clearer; the rates and variant rules haven’t changed. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: More image inputs where supported
daily.text: Image-URL conversion now uses each model’s advertised limit instead of stopping at eight images. That allows up to 30 for Kimi K2.6 and 20 for supported Bedrock models. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
